title: Set default serif, sans-serif, and monospace fonts
summary: Map the generic font aliases (serif, sans-serif, monospace) to specific font families. This ensures consistent font usage across applications that rely on these standard names.

steps.explain: Edit ~/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf and add <alias binding="strong"> blocks for serif, sans-serif, and monospace, specifying preferred families for each.

warnings: Ensure the specified fonts are installed on the system, otherwise fallback fonts will be used.
